accountedBytesScope: All selected Python base runtime, venv site-packages including SPARK_HOME, JDK home, external runtime-JAR roots, deduplicated by device/inode; plus other retained inputs and the fresh attempt root. Full runtime trees receive byte-size and metadata custody; selected pins and package provenance files receive SHA-256 custody.

action.lockCustody: Materializer and action use the stable lock sequentially; after the action closes, cleanup reacquires it, verifies ownership, deletes only exact tables, and retains lock/receipt; parent verifies post-child absence and receipt linkage.

candidateBasis.note: R12 rebinds the entire Ashlar package source/resource tree and pyproject.toml at current sourceRevision, including local-current-delta4_umf.py and all six local-current-delta4 resources omitted from R11 retainedInputs. It reuses R11 runtime inventory bytes and selected runtime roots. This is a proposal only; R11 exact authorization does not apply and no native action was run.

cleanupBlocker: R9 one-attempt refusal is preserved under its R9 evidence directory and private attempt parent; R9 Delta fixtures and ownership receipt remain intact. R10 adds the selected GraphFrames Python distribution path and exact content preflight before Spark or fixture effects. No R10 execution authorization is issued.

hardBounds.processGroup: one child session; terminate/kill group and reap leader
hardBounds.sparkScratch: entirely under the fresh accounted attempt root

runtime.runtimeTreeAccounting: Every regular file and directory entry is retained with byte sizes and stat identity; selected Python/JDK/Spark/JAR pins and Python origin/distribution metadata are SHA-256 bound. Full-content hashing of every distribution-tree file is intentionally not claimed.
